channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker

item.title: Pakistan says significant progress made in talks on Iran-US war
item.description: The talks were held during a daylong diplomatic mission to Tehran by Pakistan’s army chief and interior minister.

item.title: The Iran war is bringing cyberwarfare into critical infrastructure
item.description: Recent attacks in the UK and the US demonstrate critical vulnerabilities that governments need to urgently address.

item.title: Two US carrier groups in Middle East strain navy resources
item.description: Deploying two US carrier strike groups to the Middle East represents a significant concentration of firepower

item.title: Israel’s Netanyahu claims Iran tried to kill one of his sons
item.description: Netanyahu's claim comes after US and Israel killed Iran's supreme leader and four members of his family in Tehran.

item.title: Man killed in world’s largest annual bullfighting event in Mexico
item.description: The world’s largest open road bullfighting event turned deadly when a 29-year-old man was killed.

item.title: Brutal gang attack on strategic Haiti hillside leaves at least 30 dead
item.description: At least 30 people have been killed in a gang attack on a hillside community that overlooks routes into Haiti's capital.

item.title: Iran war live: Pakistan reports progress on restoring US-Iran MoU
item.description: Pakistan’s interior minister says significant progress made during talks with Iran's president.

item.title: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
item.description: The US calls its latest sanctions on Iran an "economic D-Day", but Tehran says it has a plan to address them.

item.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
item.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.

item.title: Four arrested over suspected poisoning of elephants in Kenya
item.description: An investigation is looking into whether the deaths were caused by pesticides sprayed on tomato crops.
